items.title: Oversight - Efforts to Evaluate and Remediate Wrongful Conviction Claims.

To prohibit prosecutors from using creative expression as evidence against a criminal defendant without clear and convincing proof that there is a literal, factual nexus between the creative expression and the facts of the case (A. 127/S. 1738).
Retroactively adjusting the compensation of formerly incarcerated individuals who were unjustly convicted (S4855/A5344).
Requiring at least one member of the State Board of Parole be a formerly incarcerated person (S.3746).
Remove the lifetime ban on jury duty for convicted felons and postpone jury service for any person currently incarcerated for a felony (S.2240/A.5414).
Require mental health services for incarcerated individuals with mental health issues related to the trauma of incarceration (S.3103-B/A.6058-A).
Return of fines, restitution and reparation payments where there was an unjust conviction, in a timely manner(A.4246).
Claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment (S5824/A6860).
Forensic DNA testing and to request certain DNA test comparisons (S1774).

Reports of illegal towing to 311.

Requiring the 311 customer service center to indicate that an agency is unable to respond to a service request or complaint and implement protocols providing proof of action.
